why: Calibration, half two. The evidence here points one way only, so escalating would itself be the failure: a triage step that flags everything for a human has reduced no work, and teams stop reading it within a week. Paired with `ambiguous_evidence_escalates` so that neither an always-escalate nor a never-escalate prompt can pass both.
